definitions.explanation: Something incorrect or wrong, a deviation from what is accurate.

examples.english: To avoid repeating the same mistake, I thoroughly investigated the cause.

notes:
{誤|あやま}り is the noun form of the verb {誤|あやま}る (to err). It refers to errors, mistakes, or inaccuracies, with a slightly formal tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誤|あやま}りがある: there is an error
- {誤|あやま}りを{犯|おか}す: to commit an error
- {誤|あやま}りを{認|みと}める: to admit a mistake
- {誤|あやま}りを{正|ただ}す: to correct an error
- {誤|あやま}りに{気|き}づく: to notice a mistake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間違|まちが}い: mistake (general, everyday — most common)
- {誤|あやま}り: error (slightly formal, often written/official contexts)
- ミス: mistake (loanword, casual — common in workplaces)
- {過|あやま}ち: mistake, fault (literary/moral connotation)

Do not confuse with {謝|あやま}り (apology), from the verb {謝|あやま}る (to apologize) — different kanji, same reading.
